comment: Curated Pāli set phrases that unambiguously determine a word's dictionary entry in the Gloss tab. 'phrase' is the human-readable phrase; the seeder normalizes it with normalize_gloss_context before insert. 'word' is the surface form the rule applies to. 'selected_uid' is the key: the numeric DPD headword uid ('<id>/dpd'), stable across DPD releases. 'selected_lemma' is the DPD lemma_1 of that id, for the reader; the seeder reports it when it differs from the installed DPD. A new rule may give only 'selected_lemma', which must name exactly one headword. See docs/gloss-ai-word-selection.md.
